t.Condições de revenda claras e preço de a: Clear reseller terms and a wholesale price per unit. You know exactly what you pay and set your own sales strategy.

t.Cada dispositivo também pode ser acessad: Each device can also be reached by link or QR Code, making it easy to share with customers.
t.A StarTouch foi pensada para entregar um: StarTouch was designed to deliver an experience that keeps creating value after the sale. For you, that means more selling points and higher perceived value. For your customer, it means getting started without being locked into a subscription.
t.Os recursos gratuitos permanecem disponí: The free features remain available with no mandatory monthly fee. And if they want to go further, they can sign up for additional StarTouch features whenever it makes sense for the business.
t.Você cuida da venda. A StarTouch cuida d: You handle the sale. StarTouch handles the technology.
t.Escolhe as quantidades, o frete é calcul: Choose the quantities, shipping is calculated from your CEP (postal code) and you pay right away. NF-e invoice on every order.
t.Cada unidade sai com identificação única: Each unit ships with a unique ID written to the chip and linked to the QR Code.
t.Os dispositivos chegam prontos para ativ: The devices arrive ready to activate. No setup needed on your end.
t.Ele encosta o celular, cria a conta e pa: They tap their phone, create an account and start managing their own dashboard.

t.Não. Não há taxa de adesão, mensalidade: No. There's no sign-up fee, no monthly fee and no exclusivity. You buy the devices and resell them at whatever price you want.
t.O sistema é mesmo vitalício?: Is the system really for life?
t.A ativação é feita pelo próprio cliente: The customer activates the device on their own, and platform support is provided by StarTouch (in Portuguese). You handle the sale; the platform handles the rest.
t.Qual o prazo total até eu receber?: How long until I receive my order?
t.Você paga produtos + frete agora. A NF-e: You pay for products + shipping now. The NF-e invoice is issued to the CNPJ you provided.
t.Esse pedido precisa de frete fechado na: This order needs a manual shipping quote. Send the request and we'll reply with the price within one business day.
t.Informe o CEP de entrega para calcular o: Enter the delivery CEP to calculate shipping.
t.Pedido recebido. Respondemos com o frete: Order received. We'll reply with the shipping cost, delivery time and invoice within one business day, by the email and WhatsApp you provided.
t.Pedido registrado. Estamos confirmando o: Order registered. We're confirming your payment — you'll get an email as soon as everything goes through.
t.Pagamento confirmado. A nota fiscal e o: Payment confirmed. The invoice and tracking code will arrive at the email you provided — production takes 10 business days and the carrier's delivery time starts after dispatch.
t.Boleto gerado — o pedido só entra em pro: Boleto issued — the order only goes into production once the payment clears (1 to 3 business days). The boleto was sent to the email you provided; keep the link, it's the only way to complete the purchase.
t.Pagamento não concluído. Seu pedido cont: Payment not completed. Your order is still here — just calculate shipping and try again.

h.Você já tem os clientes.Nós temos a tecn:
You already have the customers.
We have the technology.
Let's grow together.
h.Revenda soluções StarTouch e leve aos se: Resell StarTouch solutions and give your customers much more than NFC devices. You offer technology that helps businesses win more reviews, track their presence on Google, understand their competitors and measure results — with no mandatory monthly fee.
h.Exclusivo para pessoa jurídica · Pedido: For registered businesses only · Minimum order of R$ 2.000 + shipping
h.Para quem revende, isso significa mais v: For resellers, that means more perceived value, more selling points and a ready-made solution to offer your customer base.
h.Vitalício é vitalício. Seu cliente paga: Lifetime means lifetime. Your customer pays once for the device and never pays again to use the dashboard* — no monthly fee, no expiry, no “first year free”. It's a promise you can make without worry.
h.* Exceto o StarTouch Pro, assinatura opc: * Except StarTouch Pro, an optional subscription with additional features. Nothing that's already included depends on it.
h.Monte seu pedido, informe o CEP e veja o: Build your order, enter your CEP (postal code) and see shipping instantly. Everything is completed on the website, with online payment and an NF-e invoice for your CNPJ.
If the company is exempt, write ISENTO. This is what lets us issue the NF-e invoice.
h.Sim, e não é uma questão de confiança: é:
Yes, and it's not a matter of trust: it's how the product was built. The device points to an address of ours that redirects the same way for everyone, with or without a plan — there has never been a payment check on that path, so there's nothing to switch off for lack of one. It's not a 30-day trial or a first-year promotion. There is an optional paid plan, the Smart Menu, which the customer signs up for only if they want to; if they never do, the device and the dashboard keep working exactly the same.

And it's not just our intention: it's written in section 5.2 of the Terms of Use. What's already yours stays yours — if a feature that's free today ever moves to the paid plan, the change applies only to devices bought after it. Anyone who already has theirs loses nothing.
h.É calculado na hora da compra, pelo peso: It's calculated at checkout, based on the order's actual weight and the delivery CEP, with the carriers that serve your region. You choose the service and see the price added to the total before you pay.
h.São até 10 dias úteis de produção, conta: Up to 10 business days of production, counted from payment confirmation, plus the carrier's transit time. The time shown next to each shipping option already adds both — it's the time until it reaches your door, not just transit.
h.Monte seu primeiro pedido e leve aos seu: Build your first order and bring your customers a solution that combines a physical product and technology, with permanent features and no mandatory monthly fee.
